_comment: DB-01 / D12. Each entry: {"skip": {plugin: reason}, "note": why}. Pairings are fixed: ownership <- no-tenant, softDelete <- ttl-expiry, idempotency-claim (D69) or by-design-hard-delete (D73), audit <- machine-writes. lifeCycle has no exemption reason. A file that defines several models keys each one as <file>#<Model>.

maestro/modules/core/database/schemas/cr.note: Cluster-wide job lock: no company, expireAfterSeconds:0 on expiresAt, renewed every few seconds.

maestro/modules/core/database/schemas/pe.note: Per-server metric rollup: no company, TTL index, written by the metrics jobs.

maestro/modules/core/database/schemas/ap.note: Raw API access log: TTL on createdAt, one write per request.

maestro/modules/core/database/schemas/cr.note: Execution history: retention TTL on finishedAt, written by the cron runner.

maestro/modules/core/database/schemas/us.note: Users span companies (architect, D12). Users are never deleted; access is deactivated per company role, account deletion is a separate platform step (D57, D73).

maestro/modules/finance/database/schemas.note: Provider webhook idempotency claims: no company, written by the webhook handler, and release() must hard-delete a failed claim so the unique index frees it for the provider's redelivery (D69).

maestro/modules/core/database/schemas/au.note: The audit trail itself: auditing it would recurse, and it is append-only (erasure blanks values in place, D57) (D73).

maestro/modules/core/database/schemas/ch.note: Chat channels are hidden per user and hard-deleted by design (D73).

maestro/modules/core/database/schemas/me.note: Chat messages are hidden per user and hard-deleted by design (D73).

maestro/modules/core/database/schemas/la.note: Per-user read marker: derived state, the company comes from the channel (D73).

maestro/modules/core/database/schemas/ro.note: Global permission catalog shared by every company, pruned by the boot sync (TD-T13) (D73). Written only by the boot sync; the company-scoped audit log cannot record it.

maestro/modules/carRental/database/schem.note: Per-company search counters, upserted by the public search.

maestro/modules/propertyManagement/datab.note: Computed dashboard cache; TTL index on computedAt (3600 s).

maestro/modules/swissOutreach/database/s.note: Pipeline step log written by the orchestrator.

maestro/modules/finance/database/schemas.note: Per-company invoice number counter, upserted with $inc inside each invoice issue; the issued invoice carries the audit entry.
